evidence: sydent/http/httpserver.py:61-129 route table built exclusively with root.putChild / matrix.putChild / identity.putChild / v1.putChild / v2.putChild registrations for /_matrix/identity/* endpoints
All servlets extend twisted.web.resource.Resource and implement render_POST/render_GET(self, request) (28 handler methods under sydent/http/servlets/)
framework.framework_reference_note: No twisted reference exists in augur-0.3.0/references/ (django.md, flask.md, fastapi.md do not match this codebase). Per WORKFLOW.md 4.2.3 the language reference plus repository-derived source/sink shapes were used instead.

project_purpose.description: Sydent is the reference Matrix Identity Server: it validates third-party identifiers (email / msisdn), stores 3pid->mxid associations, signs them, and replicates associations between identity-server peers. It contacts remote homeservers over the custom 'matrix://' federation scheme to verify signed JSON and deliver bind callbacks.

entry_points.client_api_http: ClientApiHttpServer (sydent/http/httpserver.py:36) - public /_matrix/identity/api/v1 and /v2 endpoints on clientapi.http.port (default 8090), e.g. validate/email/requestToken, 3pid/bind, store-invite, account/register, lookup, hash_details, sign-ed25519, terms
entry_points.internal_api_http: InternalApiHttpServer (sydent/http/httpserver.py:143) - /_matrix/identity/internal/bind|unbind, bound to ::1 by default, 'assumed authenticated out of band' (authenticated_bind_threepid_servlet.py:23-26)
entry_points.replication_https: ReplicationHttpsServer (sydent/http/httpserver.py:171) - /_matrix/identity/replicate/v1/push, authenticated by client TLS certificate CN matched against the peers table (replication.py:42-51)
entry_points.outbound: FederationHttpClient / MatrixFederationAgent (matrix:// scheme, SRV + .well-known routing), ReplicationHttpsClient (peer replication push), SimpleHttpClient (OpenMarket SMS gateway), smtplib (verification email)

source_families.request_body_and_query_args: get_args(request, ...) (sydent/http/servlets/__init__.py:41-123) materializes the untrusted dict from json.loads(request.content.read()) (POST/PUT JSON) or request.args (query string / form, v1 + GET fallback). 22 call sites across the servlets plus sydent/http/auth.py:45.
source_families.request_field_reads: request.args attribute reads (sydent/sydent.py:374-375 brand hint, sydent/http/servlets/__init__.py:87), request.getHeader('Authorization') (sydent/http/auth.py:41), request.requestHeaders.getRawHeaders('Authorization') X-Matrix federation header (sydent/hs_federation/verifier.py:194), getRawHeaders('X-Forwarded-For') (sydent/sydent.py:361).
source_families.field_level_subscripts: args[...] / body[...] / inJson.get(...) / signed_json['signatures'] reads on the parsed request dicts, restricted to the field names actually read in the servlets (matrix_server_name, mxid, threepid, next_link, email, phone_number, medium, address, room_id, sender, token, sid, client_secret, access_token, addresses, algorithm, pepper, threepids, public_key, private_key, user_accepts, send_attempt, country, sgAssocs, signatures).
source_families.handler_boundary_functions: render_POST / render_GET(self, request) methods of Resource subclasses under sydent/http/servlets/ (28 methods) - the twisted equivalent of framework route handlers; the request parameter is at index 1.
source_families.network_target_parameters: Verifier._getKeysForServer(server_name) (sydent/hs_federation/verifier.py:63) whose argument is interpolated into 'matrix://%s/_matrix/key/v2/server/'; RemotePeer.__init__(sydent, server_name, port, ...) (sydent/replication/peer.py:107) whose server_name/port are DB-derived replication push targets.
source_families.config_and_environment: os.environ.get (sydent/sydent.py:81, :84, :112, :508 - SYDENT_SERVER_NAME / SYDENT_PID_FILE / SYDENT_DB_PATH / SYDENT_CONF), sydent.cfg.get('email', 'email.smtphost') (sydent/util/emailutils.py:88) and sydent.cfg.get("peer.%s", 'base_replication_url') (sydent/replication/peer.py:127) - operator configuration, expected FP material for remote SSRF, kept for labeling recall.

observed_guards.note: Guards observed in the current source (context for Step 3 sanitizer labeling; not extracted as candidates in Step 2):
observed_guards.hostname_validation: is_valid_hostname (sydent/util/stringutils.py:39) applied to matrix_server_name (registerservlet.py:52), MXID server part (threepid/bind.py:146) and X-Matrix origin (verifier.py:208)
observed_guards.file_scheme_check: next_link startswith('file:///') rejection (emailservlet.py:65/:106) - open-redirect guard, Pass 9 territory
observed_guards.authentication: authV2 bearer-token auth for v2 endpoints (sydent/http/auth.py:37); X-Matrix signature verification (verifier.authenticate_request); TLS certificate CN peer authentication for replication push (replication.py:42-51); internal API 'authenticated out of band' assumption with default ::1 bind

coverage_gaps: No urllib.request.urlopen / urllib.request.urlretrieve / requests / httpx call sites exist anywhere in the indexed sydent source; the python.md Pass-3 sink list therefore only maps to the twisted Agent request sites extracted here.

Twisted internals (twisted.web.client.Agent, twisted.internet.endpoints.HostnameEndpoint, twisted.names.client, smtplib) are external to the database (only six.moves stubs are present), so sink matching is AST call-site based (module-qualified name + object name + argument index), not resolved-API based.
signedjson / nacl / unpaddedbase64 / phonenumbers / netaddr / attr / sentry_sdk / prometheus_client are external dependencies; only call sites in sydent code are extractable.

The v1/v2 servlet render_OPTIONS methods, v1_servlet/v2_servlet version endpoints and the prometheus start_http_server listener are request metadata / server-side listeners, not client egress; excluded.

URL construction and parsing (urllib.parse.quote in verifier/registerservlet/emailvalidator, URI.fromBytes in matrixfederationagent.py:141, 'matrix://%s' % ... string formatting) is deliberately NOT extracted as sinks; per the extraction contract they are flow intermediates, tracked to the actual Agent.request sites.
request.setHeader('Location', next_link) redirects (emailservlet.py:108, msisdnservlet.py:129) are open-redirect (Pass 9), not CWE-918; documented here, excluded from extraction.
Local file opens (templates, config, pidfile, sqlite scripts) are Pass 1 territory; excluded.
scripts/sydent-bind and scripts/generate-key are bash; matrix_is_test/ and tests/ are test harnesses; setup.py is packaging metadata - all excluded from candidate scope.
